row.name: Forrester Research Inc. Common Stock

checks.label: not up two days in a row
checks.threshold: up_run <= 1, counting days above +1.0%; veto at 3+ up closes of any size

checks.label: linearity of the prior leg
checks.threshold: ER >= 0.4 or R2 >= 0.55 (both for A+); failing is a veto

checks.label: young trend: first or second breakout
checks.threshold: prior breakouts since the move started <= 1 (0 for A+)

checks.label: narrow or negative day before
checks.threshold: prior day negative or range < 2.0% (A+: negative and under its 20-session median range)

checks.label: consolidation quality
checks.display: base_sessions=22 breakdowns=0 bursts_in_base=0 giveback=0.31 tightness=0.71 base_volume_vs_leg=0.84 base_volume_vs_avg=1.1
checks.threshold: base 3-20 sessions, breakdowns <= 1, giveback <= 0.34, tightness <= 1.0 (A+: 0 breakdowns, 0 bursts inside, giveback <= 0.25, tightness <= 0.7, base volume under the leg's and the 50-session average)
checks.note: base of 22 sessions is outside Bonde's 3-20

checks.label: close near the high
checks.threshold: close_pos >= 0.8 and close > open (A+ >= 0.9; partial from 0.7)

checks.label: range expansion
checks.threshold: today's range over the largest of the prior 5 >= 1.0 (A+: also over the prior 10)

checks.label: higher volume
checks.threshold: volume > prior session (A+: rank <= 3 of the last 60); a base over 21 sessions also needs >= 1.5x the 50-session average
checks.note: base over 21 sessions: +CV applies, volume must be >= 1.5x average and a catalyst is needed, which bars cannot show

notes: extension: close 1.4% vs its 20-SMA, -1.6% over 20 sessions
prior breakouts worked 4 of 4 (closed higher 3 sessions later, last 4 in 60 sessions)

claude.reason: The VOL check is a hard FAIL: the base exceeds 21 sessions, triggering the catalyst-volume requirement, and the burst day's volume ranked only 21st of the last 60 sessions with just 1.07x the 50-session average against a 1.5x threshold. The base itself is 22 sessions (outside the 3–20 window, C PARTIAL), and visually the shaded consolidation region shows a declining drift from the September highs near $12.75 down toward $11, with several overlapping red bars — not the tight, orderly shelf Bonde wants. These two independent defects together pull the setup below A quality.
claude.key_risk: Volume on the burst day is far too thin for a 22-session base, and the base is a slow downtrend rather than a flat consolidation, meaning there is overhead supply from every session that bought above $11.65.
claude.entry_note: Skip if the open is below the burst-day close of $11.65 or if volume in the first 30 minutes is tracking below the prior session's full-day pace.
